# EuroFilm

> EuroFilm is a movie discovery site: official trailers, ratings and release dates for current, upcoming and top-rated films, anime and TV series, plus longform movie reviews.

Contact: contact@eurofilm.xyz

## Sections
- [Popular movie trailers](https://eurofilm.xyz/): what audiences are watching this week
- [Movies in theaters now](https://eurofilm.xyz/now-playing)
- [Upcoming movies](https://eurofilm.xyz/upcoming): new trailers and release dates
- [Top rated movies](https://eurofilm.xyz/top-rated)
- [Anime](https://eurofilm.xyz/anime): top anime series and anime film trailers
- [TV shows](https://eurofilm.xyz/tv-shows)
- [Bollywood and Indian movies](https://eurofilm.xyz/bollywood)
- [Oscar winners](https://eurofilm.xyz/oscars)
- [Movie news](https://eurofilm.xyz/news)
- [Blog: movie reviews and film essays](https://eurofilm.xyz/blog)

## Data sources
Movie data and trailers come from TMDB and YouTube; anime data from the Jikan (MyAnimeList) API.
